svg.title: Current finances · Assets & debts wireframe
svg.text: Assets and liabilities stay separate so net worth is auditable.
A financed asset writes two rows: the asset value here and a liability below. The house shows $289,000; the mortgage
Debt rows carry balance, APR, payment, and term. Payoff behaviour ships in a later slice (#15).
Turning Financed on reveals mortgage fields without a second form. Turning it off removes the liability row on save.
Gauges and the header agree: Assets $289,000 − Liabilities $56,974 = Net worth $232,026.
